mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_storage_cleanup_tasks (id, storage_key, reason, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}, #{storageKey}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', 0, #{nextAttemptAt}) ON CONFLICT (storage_key) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM media_storage_cleanup_tasks WHERE (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now})) AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE media_storage_cleanup_tasks task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = task.attempt_count + 1, next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil} FROM candidates WHERE task.id = candidates.id RETURNING task.id, task.storage_key, task.reason, task.status, task.attempt_count, task.next_attempt_at
mapper.update: UPDATE media_storage_cleanup_tasks SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'RUNNING'
